subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Faria said, "Raihan, do you like my village?" "I really like the calmness here," said Raihan. "Let's enjoy the scenery over there." "It's a great idea! I will love it," said Raihan.
guide_solution: Faria asked Raihan if he liked her village. Raihan replied that he really liked the calmness there. Faria suggested that they should enjoy the scenery over there. Raihan exclaimed with joy that it was a great idea and said that he would love it.
